### POST /api/v1/accounts/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `accounts_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/accounts/` |
| Business purpose | Add (accounts). Everyone who can (or could) sign in. Staff accounts follow the person's employment status; accounts of people who are not staff are switched off and on here. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-IAM-015](../../../requirements/identity-and-access.md#hims-iam-015), [HIMS-IAM-006](../../../requirements/identity-and-access.md#hims-iam-006), [HIMS-IAM-005](../../../requirements/identity-and-access.md#hims-iam-005) |
| Actor / permission required | `accounts.manage` (Add sign-in accounts for people who are not staff, switch accounts off or on, reset their two-factor and sign them out). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session; a "confirm it's you" within the last 15 minutes is required |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | `AccountCreateRequest`: `email` (required, email), `display_name` (required, ≤ 150 characters), `reason` (required, ≤ 2000 characters) |
| Response schema | 201 `Account` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | `Idempotency-Key` header (optional; operation `accounts.create`): the same key with the same body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); with a different body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; kept 48 hours |
| Concurrency control | No version check (adds a new record or is a one-off action); unique rules in the database refuse duplicates |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `user.account.created` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client may retry a lost answer with the same Idempotency-Key |
| Expected error codes | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, 400 `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 403 `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/identity/tests/test_accounts.py::test_add_account_for_someone_who_is_not_staff`, `apps/identity/tests/test_accounts.py::test_permissions`, `apps/identity/tests/test_confirm_identity.py::test_five_wrong_tries_end_the_session` |
